final: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), first_group AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS benchmark FROM per_order), first_kept AS (SELECT p.avg_fill, p.avg_fill - b.benchmark AS margin1 FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN first_group b WHERE p.avg_fill > b.benchmark), second_group AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS benchmark FROM first_kept), final_kept AS (SELECT f.avg_fill, f.margin1, f.avg_fill - s.benchmark AS margin2 FROM first_kept f CROSS JOIN second_group s WHERE f.avg_fill > s.benchmark) SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS avg_fill_size, AVG(margin1) AS avg_margin_over_first_benchmark, AVG(margin2) AS avg_margin_over_second_benchmark FROM final_kept
